name: Hungarian Parliament: doors
_about: Steindl's Parliament: the three great doors of the porch on Kossuth Square (the main entrance, into the stair hall), the door from the river arcade into the river centre, and the doors in the end pavilions' ends -- oak under neo-Gothic ironwork. The river arcade's arches stand open.

doors._about: the main entrance: the porch's three doors on Kossuth Square
from the river arcade into the river centre
